risks.risk: Oven/compartment may not heat properly (common fault not shown by burner flames).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the oven preheating and reaching temperature (or a thermometer reading) with the oven door closed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as burners working but oven not confirmed (worst case: oven not working).

risks.risk: Electric coil burners may be weak/defective even if present.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing each electric coil turning red/working at different knob settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electric coils not working (worst case: only gas burners confirmed).

risks.risk: Ignition/knob control issues (some burners may light only sometimes).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip where each gas burner is turned on from off and lights consistently (one by one).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for consistent ignition (worst case: one burner unreliable).

risks.risk: Gas safety issues: leaks, damaged hoses/valves, or poor burner alignment.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the gas inlet/valve area and a leak test result (or a video using soapy water at connections).
risks.if_unproven: Price with safety risk assumed until tested (worst case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Condition/age not verifiable; hidden rust or worn burner caps/grates.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of burner caps, grates, and the oven interior (top/bottom) showing wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: cosmetic/parts wear).

proof_requests: Video: oven turned on and preheating (door closed) with a thermometer reading or clear heat-up time.
Video: each electric coil burner working (turn on from off; show glow/red heat at low and high).
Video: each gas burner ignition from off one-by-one to confirm consistent lighting.
Close-up photos of gas inlet/valve area and burner caps/grates; plus a soapy-water leak test clip at connections.
Photos of the receipt/warranty card and a readable rating/serial label (brand/model).
response.reason: The photos support that it has 4 gas burners plus 2 electric hotplates (6 total), but they do not prove the oven and electric coils fully work or that there are no gas safety issues. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
